verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents a public Teams API that lets external services automate Teams. It covers posting chatMessages to channels, creating teams, adding members, configuring channels/tabs/apps, and exporting chat and channel messages, with incoming and outgoing webhooks as lighter options. A community comment notes integration requires the full Azure/Graph stack, which reflects setup complexity rather than a missing API. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at the probed paths, no independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use, and authentication/setup overhead is not documented in the pack.
